leeroy.definition:
n.\r
 1: One who does not grasp the concept of caution.\r
 2: One whose success is based purely off relentless aggression and pure luck.\r
 3: One who likes chicken.\r
 4: One whose battle cry consists of their own name.\r
\r
v.\r
 1: To destroy all hopes of success.\r
 2: To rush headlong into danger without regard to consequences.\r
 3: To satisfy one's own desires at the expense of all around oneself.
> - I can't believe he just tried to headbutt that dragon.  What a Leeroy.
> - We were doing great until that idiot totally Leeroyed us.
> - The party was really boring until Bob pulled a Leeroy.
